results.title: Earth-abundant solar absorbers: which crystals to compute next
results.summary: Six agents built a ranking method that found all 4 excellent solar absorbers on held-out data in 8 expensive calculations, against 20 for the textbook rule. A later check of a rebuilt copy beat the textbook rule in 20 of 20 pools. Includes 15 materials to compute next.
